hints.title: Binary Tree In-Degree Rules
hints.text: A valid binary tree has exactly one root with in-degree 0, and every other node must have in-degree exactly 1.

hints.title: Single Root Identification
hints.text: Count in-degrees for all children. If multiple nodes or no nodes have in-degree 0, return false.

hints.title: Cycle and Connectivity Check
hints.text: Traverse from the identified root (BFS/DFS). Verify that all n nodes are reachable with zero cycles.

hints.title: See the blueprint

complexity.whyNaiveFails: Assuming node 0 is always the root fails; roots can be any node with in-degree 0.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: In-degree array identifies candidate root in O(N); BFS verifies connectivity in O(N).
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Candidate checks: (1) no child has in-degree > 1, (2) exactly one root, (3) all n nodes reachable.
complexity.notes: Must guard against disconnected forests and internal cycles.
